title: When doubt keeps circling the fire
subtitle: Let the Guru's word outlast the argument
description: A three-step bundle for the hour when second-guessing is feeding its own heat. It brings the mind from wandering argument into the Guru-word that kills ego and thirst at the root.

heroSource.shortMeaning: The shabad says doubt is an inner fire, and the Guru’s teaching is the way devotion becomes possible again.
heroSource.lifeApplication: Stop giving the argument another lap; place one Guru-given word inside the mind and let it answer the heat directly.

evidence.coreClaim: This bundle treats doubt as fire rather than intelligence. It asks the mind to become Gurmukh enough to let the Guru’s words live where ego and thirst have been speaking.
evidence.turn: Let one received teaching become stronger than another round of private argument.
evidence.practicalImplication: Move through the steps by naming the fire, choosing one line of obedience, and refusing to feed the doubt with more wandering.
